tests.title: Simple object
tests.prompt: A single glossy red ceramic mug centered on a plain white table, studio lighting, no other objects.
judge_questions: Is the mug on a white table?

tests.title: Objects and relation
tests.prompt: A blue cube on the left and a yellow sphere on the right, both resting on a smooth gray floor, clean studio scene.
judge_questions: Is the blue cube to the left of the yellow sphere?

tests.title: Count, color and position
tests.prompt: Three green apples in a horizontal row. A small red ball floats directly above the middle apple. Plain light background.
judge_questions: How many green apples are visible?
Is the red ball above the middle apple?

tests.title: Text rendering
tests.prompt: A minimal white rectangular sign photographed straight-on. The sign contains only the large black uppercase text: LOCAL AI. No other words or symbols.
judge_questions: What exact text is written on the sign?

tests.title: Photorealism
tests.prompt: Photorealistic close-up photograph of a vintage mechanical wristwatch on a dark wooden desk beside a fountain pen, soft morning window light, realistic materials and reflections.

tests.title: Illustration / concept art
tests.prompt: Polished concept-art illustration of a compact futuristic home AI server room, two small rack cabinets, soft indirect lighting, tidy cables, readable spatial depth, cinematic but practical design.

tests.title: Technical UI illustration
tests.prompt: Clean desktop analytics dashboard UI mockup for a local AI benchmark. Include a left navigation, a table comparing three models, and two simple performance charts. Modern light interface, clear hierarchy, no logos.
